newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Palestinian dies of wounds from West Bank clash.
newsitem.headline: Palestinian dies of wounds from West Bank clash.

text.p: A Palestinian youth shot in the head by Israeli troops during a West Bank clash this week died of his wounds in a Ramallah hospital on Wednesday, hospital sources said.
"Ashraf Abdel Rahman Matour, 16 years old, died from a bullet in the head today," Samer Anabtawi, administrative director of Ramallah hospital, told Reuters.
Matour was critically wounded when stone-throwing Palestinians clashed with Israeli troops on Monday in the West Bank village of Beit Sahour near PLO-ruled Bethlehem.

He was due to be buried in his home village of Seir near Hebron on Wednesday. The West Bank and Gaza have been tense since Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu broke ground on a new Jewish settlement in Arab East Jerusalem four months ago.
